shots.content: Inside a seminar room, a rectangular worktable stands between a pinboard and the entrance, with windows along one side. A woman in a navy blazer introduces the agenda at the pinboard-side window seat. A woman in an olive blouse is at the pinboard-side aisle seat. A man in a burgundy polo is at the entrance-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the entrance end, looking lengthwise along the worktable toward the pinboard, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.

shots.content: A man in a mustard sweater enters, takes the entrance-side window seat, and asks a question, and a woman in a navy blazer answers.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A man in a burgundy polo asks a question, and a woman in a navy blazer replies.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the pinboard end, looking lengthwise along the worktable toward the entrance, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.
